mods.name: Fabric API
mods.note: Core library that almost every Fabric mod needs in order to run

mods.name: Mod Menu
mods.note: Adds a Mods button to the main menu so you can see what's installed

mods.name: Simple Voice Chat
mods.note: Proximity voice chat: you hear players who are close to you or connected in groups. Everyone who wants to talk needs it installed. (Highly Recommended)

mods.name: Voxy Server Side
mods.note: Addon for Voxy World Gen that saves generated chunks to server so you don't need to explore and load chunks to make voxy work.
